prompts.text: # Build: readme-rule-every-build (Opus, low thinking; tiny rules change) ## What Brett said (verbatim, Nov 4 2026, voice) "We gotta structure the documentation engine later anyway, so leave that out. Just get basic documentation. In Markdown." Asked whether every future build should include a basic Markdown readme: "Yeah." Book to a free named agent. ## Do - Add a standing rule to `_claude/rules/RULES.md`, `CLAUDE.md` and every build-brief template/boilerplate the orchestrator and build_start use: **every build ships a basic Markdown readme for what it adds or changes, in the same PR**: `docs…
prompts.output: Done, boss. **PR #337** is open and will merge itself once CI goes green. **What's in it:** - **The rule** is now in `_claude/rules/RULES.md` and `CLAUDE.md`. Every build has to ship a plain Markdown `docs/README.md` in its plugin, app or module folder, in the same PR. It covers what the thing does…
